dialog.english:
��������This is the base of Infinity
Mountain.
dialog.translation: Esta es la base del Monte Mugen.

dialog.english:
That's where Devimon's waiting for
us.
dialog.translation: Aquí es donde nos espera Devimon.

dialog.english: Heeeeeeeey!
Tai! Guys!
Joe, Sora! You're safe!
Glad we could catch up to you...

I was worried about what we'd do
if you'd left us behind.
dialog.translation:
Me preocupaba qué hacer si nos
dejábais atrás.

dialog.english: I'm really glad you two are safe!
I thought you two were gonna run.
Tai...

What's wrong, Tai? You're not
acting like yourself.
dialog.translation:
Que pasa, Tai? No pareces tú
mismo.

dialog.english:
This is a great day, because we
got to meet up with you guys
again!
dialog.translation:
Es un dia genial, por que nos
hemos podido reunir de nuevo!

dialog.english: Taiiiiii!
How rude, Tai!
Sorry, sorry!
Okay, we're all here!

And we've got Leomon helping us
out as well.
dialog.translation:
Y tenemos a Leomon de ayuda
también.

dialog.english:
Whoa! Seems like a lot's happened
while we were gone.
dialog.translation:
Uah! Ocurrieron muchas
cosas desde la última vez.

dialog.english: I'm surprised.

It's the least I can do to atone.
Please allow me to assist you.
dialog.translation:
Quiero redimirme. Dejad que os
ayude.

dialog.english: It's fine, I was just surprised.

Looking forward to working with
you!
Okay, let's go find Devimon!

I think we've got a fighting
chance against Devimon, since Sora
and Joe arrived just in time.
dialog.translation:
Creo que tenemos alguna
oportunidad contra Devimon, ya
que Sora y Joe están aquí.

dialog.english:
But Devimon's much stronger than
the enemies we've fought so far.
dialog.translation:
Pero Devimon es más fuerte
que los enemigos que tuvimos
hasta ahora

dialog.english:
True, but we can use the Digivices
now!

Yeah! We'll defeat Devimon and get
back to our world, for sure!
dialog.translation:
Si! Derrotaremos a Devimon y
volveremos a nuestro mundo!

dialog.english:
If we defeat Devimon, we'll
finally get to go home.

Finally, at last. I've missed so
many days of cram school.
dialog.translation:
Por fin. Perdí muchos dias de
escuela.

dialog.english:
Is cram school the only thing you
worry about?
dialog.translation:
Es esa escuela lo único que te
preocupa?

dialog.english:
I can't help it! I'm a student,
you know!
dialog.translation:
No lo puedo evitar! Soy
estudioso, sabes?

dialog.english:
In that case, we'll have to do our
best for the sake of your grades!
dialog.translation:
En ese caso, esfuérzate al máximo
por el bien de tus notas!

dialog.english:
You saved us when you figured out
the Digivice's secret, Izzy.
dialog.translation:
Nos salvaste con el secreto de
los dispositivos, Izzy.

dialog.english:
It was a coincidence; we just
happened to be in the old ruins.
dialog.translation:
Fué coincidencia; Resulta que
acabamos en unas viejas ruinas.

dialog.english:
But aren't you're the one who
inspected the ruins? Take credit 
for your accomplishments!
dialog.translation:
Pero no fuiste tú el que estudió
esas ruinas? No te quites el
mérito!

dialog.english: Tai...

We'll be at the top soon. Let's
take a short break.
dialog.translation:
Estaremos arriba pronto.
Descansemos un poco.

dialog.english: Head up
Talk with the others a little longer
dialog.translation: Hablar con el resto un poco más.

dialog.english: All right, let's head up!

We weren't away that long, but it
feels like we haven't seen each
other in a long time.
dialog.translation:
No estuvimos separados tanto,
pero parece que nos nos hayamos
visto en meses.

dialog.english:
Yeah. Well, a lot happened while
we were separated.

Agumon and I wound up drifting to
a place with a ton of ice and
snow...
dialog.translation:
Agumon y yo acabamos en un lugar
lleno de hielo y nieve...

dialog.english: We got captured by some ghosts.

Really? Tell me all about it when
we get home.
dialog.translation:
De veras? Cuéntame todo cuando
volvamos a casa.

dialog.english: Sure.

We're going to *another* dark and
damp place...
dialog.translation:
Vamos a otro lugar oscuro y
húmedo...

dialog.english: What on earth happened?

So we're still not done climbing
Monte Mugen...
dialog.translation:
Así que aún no subimos el Monte
Mugen...

dialog.english: Mimi, are you tired?
If you're tired, you can wait here.

I'm fine. Just a bit more and I
can go home.
dialog.translation:
Estoy bien. Un poco más y nos
vamos a casa.

dialog.english: Yeah, that's the spirit!
You've grown up a little, Mimi.
You're so mean, Palmon!

What're you saying? This mountain
is nothing to me if it means I can
go home soon!
dialog.translation:
Qué dices? Esta montaña no es
nada si significa irse a casa
pronto!

dialog.english:
Mimi, you've gotten a lot
stronger.
dialog.translation:
Mimi, eres mucho más fuerte
ahora.

dialog.english:
The first thing I'll do when I get
home is take a shower!
dialog.translation:
Lo primero que haré al volver es
darme una ducha!

dialog.english:
...Or maybe just a little
stronger.

Okay, I'll have to work hard now,
so I can take a nice shower, too!
dialog.translation:
Vale, tengo que trabajar duro
para poder darme una ducha,
también!

dialog.english:
Patamon and I were looking after a
bunch of Digimon babies!
dialog.translation:
Patamon y yo cuidamos de muchos
Digimon bebés!

dialog.english: That's great, T.K!
So Digimon hatch from eggs?

Haha! Tai, did you know that
Digimon hatch from eggs?
dialog.translation:
Vaya Tai! no sabías de dónde
nacen los Digimon?

dialog.english: Really?!

Really! I bet Agumon and the
others did, too!
dialog.translation:
Seguro que Agumon y los
demás nacieron así!

dialog.english:
(Now that I think about it, why
were Agumon and the others the 
only ones to not be born there?)
dialog.translation:
(Ahora que lo pienso, por qué
Agumon y los otros fueron los
únicos en no nacer allí?)

dialog.english:
Really! I bet Agumon and the
others did, too!
dialog.translation:
Seguro que Agumon y los demás
nacieron así!

dialog.english:
(Now that I think about it, why
were Agumon and the others the 
only ones to not be born there?)
dialog.translation:
(Ahora que lo pienso, por qué
Agumon y los otros fueron los
únicos en no nacer allí?)

dialog.english:
Did you hatch from an egg too,
Patamon?

Maybe. I don't really remember it
much.
I've been waiting, ya brats...

You don't have a chance, so why
don't you just run for it?
dialog.translation:
No puedes con nosotros, por qué
no te largas sin más?

dialog.english: I don't think so!

Huh? What's with the sudden
confidence?
dialog.translation: Eh? De donde sale esa confianza?

dialog.english:
I've become one with Devimon and
been granted power!
dialog.translation:
Ahora soy uno con el poder de
Devimon!

dialog.english: What...?!

I won't lose to you again! I'll
choke the life out of all of you!
dialog.translation:
No perderé otra vez. Os arrancaré
la vida de cuajo!

dialog.english: Ghhhh...
Did we kill Ogremon?

No, he just said he'd become one
with Devimon, so he's not dead...
dialog.translation:
No, dijo que se hizo uno con
Devimon, no creo que esté
muerto...

dialog.english:
That's not enough to stop us from
getting to Devimon. Let's hurry!
dialog.translation:
No es suficiente para frenarnos
hacia Devimon. Vayamos!

dialog.english:
Chosen Children...I can't believe
that you've managed to meet up and
appear in front of me once again.
dialog.translation:
Niños Elegidos... No puedo creer
que os juntáseis y apareciéseis
aquí, frente a mi.

dialog.english: Devimon!
Come to me, powers of darkness!
Gyaaaaah! What's this?!

The powers of darkness made him
into a giant!
dialog.translation:
El poder de la oscuridad lo ha
hecho gigante!

dialog.english:
I'll make File Island into your
graveyard!
dialog.translation:
La isla File será vuestro
cementerio!

dialog.english: He's coming at us!

So the so-called "Chosen Children"
can only do this much to me?
dialog.translation:
Estos tales "Niños Elegidos"
no pueden hacerme nada más?

dialog.english:
What...? He was only toying with
us?

It is your fate to be destroyed
here!

The powers of darkness are
expanding...!
dialog.translation:
El poder de la oscuridad
se expanden...!

dialog.english: Now...for a trial of strength...
Uwaaaaaaaaah!
Guys!

First, I shall start with the
smallest Chosen Child...
Does he mean T.K?!

If you disappear, I have nothing
left to be afraid of.
dialog.translation:
Si desapareces, no tengo nada
que temer.

dialog.english: T.Kuuuuu!
Gh...
Leomon! Are you okay?

Yes, but I don't think I have any
more power.
dialog.translation: Si, pero no tengo más energía.

dialog.english: Leomon...

(Why am I...why am I the only one
who can't evolve?)
dialog.translation:
(Por qué soy yo el único que no
digievoluciona?)

dialog.english:
All of you, watch and observe the
smallest Chosen Child's greatest
and final moment!
dialog.translation:
Observad todos el momento final
del más pequeño de los Niños
Elegidos!

dialog.english: No...I'll protect T.K!
!! Patamon...

I've decided, I'm going to stay
with T.K!

The words of a powerless Digimon
are only in vain.
dialog.translation:
Las palabras de un Digimon débil
son en vano.

dialog.english: Patamoooooooooooon!
Patamon evolved...
That's T.K's Digimon...?
dialog.translation: Ese es el Digimon de T.K?

dialog.english: He's like an angel...
Patamon?

T.K, I'm Angemon...your
friend...
Angemon...
Why, you...and I was so close!

Agumon! Everyone! Lend me your
power one more time!
dialog.translation:
Agumon! Todos! Dadme vuestro
poder una vez más!

dialog.english:
We're going to defeat Devimon!
Let's go!
Yeah!

I will erase your powers of
darkness!

Fool. You're going to lose all
your power this way, Angemon...
dialog.translation:
Idiota. Perderás tus poderes si
haces eso, Angemon...

dialog.english:
The powers of darkness exist
across the ocean as well, as do
Digimon stronger than me!
dialog.translation:
El poder de la oscuridad existe
más allá del océano, y
Digimon más fuertes que yo!

dialog.english: W-what...?!

You guys are doomed!
Hahahahahahaha...!
Angemon...

T.K...I'm sure we'll meet
again, if you wish for it.
dialog.translation:
T.K...Nos volveremos a
encontrar, así lo deseo.

dialog.english: Angemoooooooooon!
It's a DigiEgg.
It's Angemon's, right?

Angemon turned into an egg and is
starting over.
dialog.translation:
Angemon se ha convertido en huevo
de nuevo.

dialog.english:
If he evolves properly, you'll
meet him again.

Then I'll make sure to raise him
carefully.

Guys! The island is coming back
together!
dialog.translation: Chicos! La isla se está juntando.

dialog.english: Devimon? Did they kill him?

Ogremon. Do you want to fight
again?

H-haaah! I'm done with all of
this!

But...I'm worried about what
Devimon said about Digimon with
strong, dark powers...
dialog.translation:
Pero...Me preocupa lo que dijo
Devimon de Digimon más fuertes,
poder oscuro...

dialog.english: Are we gonna have to fight again?
There's not much else we can do.
W-what's this?

Huh...So you're the Chosen
Children, right?
Who's there?
I'm on your side.
There's a human here, besides us?
No, I'm human and yet not human.
dialog.translation: No, soy humano y no lo soy.

dialog.english: Are you a ghost?

My name is Gennai. Devimon's 
interference...
dialog.translation:
Me llamo Gennai, la influencia
de Devimon...

dialog.english:
...kept us from getting in touch,
but now we finally meet.
dialog.translation:
...me mantuvo apartado,
pero por fin nos conocemos.

dialog.english:
Hey, old man, were you the one who
chose us?
dialog.translation: Eh, anciado, nos has elegido tú?

dialog.english: It wasn't me.
Then, who?
Well...I don't know.
Whaaaaaat?!

I'm sending this from the other
side of the ocean. You must defeat
the enemy on Server Continent...
dialog.translation:
Os envío esto desde el otro lado
del océano. Debéis derrotar al
enemigo de Continente Server...

dialog.english:
But we don't know where that is,
or whether we can win...
dialog.translation:
Pero no sabemos dónde, ni si
podemos ganar...

dialog.english:
I'll send a map to your computer.
Find the Circuitos and Emblemas.
dialog.translation:
Os enviaré un mapa.
Encontrad los Circuitos y
Emblemas.

dialog.english: Circuitos? Emblemas?

You'll need them to make your
Digimon evolve further.

There's even *further* levels of
evolution?

So where do we find the Circuitos and
Emblemas?

Well, Devimon sealed the Circuitos
somewhere together...
dialog.translation:
Bueno, Devimon selló los
Circuitos todos juntos...

dialog.english:
What's wrong? The picture's
fuzzy?!

The Emblemas are...
scattered...Server
Continent...hurry...
dialog.translation:
Emblemas están...
repartidos por...
Continente Server...

dialog.english: He disappeared.
What the heck was that?
So what do we do now?

Hm...well, let's get down from
this mountain first, and then
we'll decide!
dialog.translation:
Hm...bueno, bajemos esta montaña
primero, luego decidiremos!

dialog.english: Head up
Talk with the others a little longer
dialog.translation: Hablar con los demás un rato más.

dialog.english:
It's the final battle, guys! Are
you ready?
dialog.translation:
Es la batalla final, chicos!
Estáis listos?

dialog.english:
Guys! We have to combine our power
and defeat Devimon!
dialog.translation:
Chicos! Debemos juntar nuestro
poder contra Devimon!
